scalar_method_results.output_meaning: Unvalidated average of four semantically different raw scores.
scalar_method_results.assumptions: Pretends the four scores share a common meaning and scale.
scalar_method_results.suitable_applications: None for consequential trust estimation; only as a didactic anti-pattern.
scalar_method_results.unsuitable_applications: Any operational release or automation decision.
scalar_method_results.failure_mode: Looks numerically plausible while hiding component incompatibility and dependence.

scalar_method_results.assumptions: The weakest component should dominate the decision threshold.
scalar_method_results.suitable_applications: Conservative gating and safety-focused review triggers.
scalar_method_results.failure_mode: Over-penalizes cases with one noisy but non-critical component.

scalar_method_results.assumptions: One strong signal can dominate the decision.
scalar_method_results.suitable_applications: Finding cases for deeper review where at least one component is promising.

scalar_method_results.output_meaning: Simple average of calibrated component event probabilities.
scalar_method_results.assumptions: Averaged component probabilities summarize the desired system event.
scalar_method_results.unsuitable_applications: General trust estimation without end-to-end labels.
scalar_method_results.failure_mode: Still ignores dependence and event mismatch.

scalar_method_results.output_meaning: Weighted average of calibrated component event probabilities.
scalar_method_results.assumptions: Weights reflect component importance and remain stable.
scalar_method_results.suitable_applications: Policy scorecards with fixed, reviewed semantics.
scalar_method_results.failure_mode: The output meaning changes with arbitrary weight choices.

scalar_method_results.output_meaning: Multiplicative-style average that penalizes low components.
scalar_method_results.assumptions: Scores share probabilistic semantics and partial independence.
scalar_method_results.unsuitable_applications: Any setting where components target different events.

scalar_method_results.output_meaning: Naive product of component event probabilities.
scalar_method_results.assumptions: Marginal probabilities can be multiplied as if independent and aligned.
scalar_method_results.suitable_applications: Rare narrow cases where chain assumptions are justified.
scalar_method_results.unsuitable_applications: This Project Frog pipeline, which has correlated failures.

scalar_method_results.output_meaning: Learned estimate of end-to-end correctness from the full score vector.
scalar_method_results.assumptions: Development labels and deployment conditions are relevant to the target setting.
scalar_method_results.suitable_applications: End-to-end probability estimation when training data and monitoring exist.
scalar_method_results.unsuitable_applications: Zero-label settings or settings with large distribution shift.
scalar_method_results.failure_mode: Can drift when score semantics or populations change.

scalar_method_results.output_meaning: Naive-Bayes estimate of end-to-end correctness from the component vector.
scalar_method_results.assumptions: Conditional independence and approximate Gaussian feature behavior given the outcome.
scalar_method_results.suitable_applications: Fast baseline when those assumptions are defensible enough to test.

policy_results.output_meaning: Accept automatically only when all component-specific thresholds are met; otherwise abstain.
policy_results.assumptions: Thresholds reflect review policy rather than probability theory.
policy_results.suitable_applications: Governed review workflows with explicit abstention.
policy_results.unsuitable_applications: Reporting a single numeric trust probability.
policy_results.failure_mode: Can be brittle around manually chosen thresholds.

policy_results.output_meaning: Keep the four scores separate and review them jointly.
policy_results.assumptions: Humans or downstream policies can use structured evidence better than a single scalar.
policy_results.suitable_applications: High-stakes review, auditing, debugging, and failure analysis.
policy_results.unsuitable_applications: Fully automated ranking that requires one scalar score.
policy_results.failure_mode: Needs governance and can slow down throughput.

policy_results.output_meaning: Convert the score vector into low/medium/high system risk bands.
policy_results.assumptions: The category boundaries are decision artifacts, not latent truths.

policy_results.output_meaning: Accept only high-confidence cases under a learned end-to-end model and abstain on the rest.
policy_results.assumptions: Human review is available and better than unsafe automation.
policy_results.failure_mode: Coverage can collapse on hard subgroups.

document_extraction.intended_meaning: Heuristic estimate that required fields were read cleanly enough to attempt downstream processing.
document_extraction.generation_method: Rule-based blend of OCR completeness, field coverage, and parser stability checks.
document_extraction.calibration_method: Isotonic mapping to extraction success for descriptive analysis only.
document_extraction.calibration_population: Synthetic development split with milder difficulty mix than deployment.
document_extraction.dependency_assumptions: Downstream classifiers behave similarly when extraction succeeds at the same observed index.
document_extraction.known_failure_modes: High scores on template-like scans with systematic field swaps.
document_extraction.valid_comparisons: Compare only to the same score on the same extraction pipeline and population.
document_extraction.invalid_interpretations: Not the probability the final system answer is correct.
document_extraction.supported_decisions: Whether to request re-scan or proceed to classification.
document_extraction.unsupported_decisions: Whether the overall case is safe to auto-approve.

classification.intended_meaning: Model-reported confidence that the predicted case class is correct.
classification.generation_method: Softmax-like score from a multi-class classifier.
classification.calibration_method: Isotonic regression fitted on the synthetic development split.
classification.calibration_population: Synthetic development split; complex cases are under-represented.
classification.dependency_assumptions: Prediction quality is conditionally stable given similar extraction quality and case difficulty.
classification.known_failure_modes: Overconfidence on difficult or ambiguous cases.
classification.valid_comparisons: Compare with later classifier outputs only after checking calibration drift.
classification.invalid_interpretations: Not directly comparable to retrieval margin or explanation self-check scores.
classification.supported_decisions: Whether to abstain or request reviewer confirmation of the predicted class.
classification.unsupported_decisions: Whether the end-to-end Project Frog packet is trustworthy without more evidence.

evidence_retrieval.intended_meaning: Margin between the top retrieved evidence chunk and the next-best chunk.
evidence_retrieval.generation_method: Normalized ranking-margin statistic from the retrieval stack.
evidence_retrieval.calibration_method: Isotonic mapping to evidence relevance for descriptive analysis only.
evidence_retrieval.calibration_population: Synthetic development split built from the same fictional policy corpus.
evidence_retrieval.dependency_assumptions: The margin is informative only for the same query formulation and corpus quality.
evidence_retrieval.known_failure_modes: Looks confident when all candidate passages are consistently wrong.
evidence_retrieval.valid_comparisons: Compare only across the same retrieval system and corpus snapshot.
evidence_retrieval.invalid_interpretations: Not the probability the predicted class or explanation is correct.
evidence_retrieval.supported_decisions: Whether to ask for broader retrieval or human evidence search.
evidence_retrieval.unsupported_decisions: Whether to multiply directly with classifier confidence.

explanation_generation.intended_meaning: Internal consistency score saying the generated rationale matches the retrieved evidence and output template.
explanation_generation.generation_method: Self-consistency and rubric matching score from the explanation model.
explanation_generation.calibration_method: Isotonic mapping to explanation adequacy for descriptive analysis only.
explanation_generation.calibration_population: Synthetic development split with shorter explanations than the evaluation split.
explanation_generation.dependency_assumptions: Template conformity is associated with adequate explanations.
explanation_generation.known_failure_modes: High scores for polished but unsupported rationales.
explanation_generation.valid_comparisons: Compare within the same explanation model and rubric version.
explanation_generation.invalid_interpretations: Not a calibrated probability of end-to-end correctness.
explanation_generation.supported_decisions: Whether to request a stronger explanation or route to human review.
explanation_generation.unsupported_decisions: Whether to auto-release a case packet without checking evidence and class correctness.
